questions.question: The walk is organised specifically for

analyses.content: 录音明确说到这个徒步活动主要针对家庭，想帮助人们和孩子一起徒步（families，with their children对应B选项）。
你可能会听到“get to know their local area better”而错选C，但录音说的是帮助“本地人”更好地了解所在的地区而不是游客；听到“normal fitness”也直接排除了A选项的“extremely fit”。
The walk is mainly aimed at families. We want to help people to walk with their children. It's healthy exercise, and it helps people get to know their local area better.

questions.question: The maximum number of people on the walk will be

analyses.content: 录音中明确提到今年能够将人数扩充到280人（two hundred and eighty对应C选项）。
你可能会听到“two hundred and twenty”而错选A，但这只是过去历史上的最高人数限制，今年的名额已经增加了。

For most of the walk's history, we set a maximum of two hundred and twenty walkers, but this year we've been able to expand to two hundred and eighty because we've got a total of fifty volunteers to help us.

questions.question: The organisers will stop walkers taking part if they

analyses.content: 录音提到唯一会把人赶走（turn them away对应stop）的情况是他们在起点表现很差（behave badly对应B选项的causing a lot of trouble）。
你可能会听到没带防水服（waterproof）或者安全问题（safety questions）而错选A或C，但录音明确说了没带衣服会借给你，安全问题也是组织者花时间解答，而不是用来赶走你的条件。

If someone arrives without proper clothing, we can help out from our stocks of waterproofs, for example. We don't just turn them away. [chuckles] The only time we do that is if people behave badly at the start. We also spend a lot of time fielding walkers' questions about safety, both before the walk and while it's going on.

questions.question: The walk was cancelled two years previously because of

analyses.content: 录音中提到几年前决定取消活动是因为没有招募到足够的志愿者来帮忙（didn't get as many volunteers对应C选项的getting people to help）。
你可能会听到前文提问的“bad weather”错选B，或者听到“felt really awful”错选A，但录音里明确说好几年没因为天气取消了，觉得awful只是因为取消活动心里难受，并不是团队生病了。

Do you ever cancel the walk for very bad weather? Yes, but it hasn't happened for several years. However, a couple of years ago, the organizers made a decision to cancel because we didn't get as many volunteers as we needed to act as stewards on the walk. The team felt really awful about it, but these things happen.

analyses.content: 录音明确说明如果你想要奖章，必须在徒步前一周提前预订（order it one week before the walk对应A选项）。
你可能会只凭零星的单词错选，但录音明确否定了走完立刻发（immediately on finishing，排除B），并指出是走完两周后通过邮寄收到（two weeks after，排除C）。

If you do complete the course, you are entitled to receive a badge. Now, unfortunately, we can't give those to you immediately on finishing. If you want one, you have to order it one week before the walk, and you'll get it by post two weeks after the walk, as long as you finish, of course.

analyses.content: 录音中特别强调这并不意味着你要穿像牛仔裤这样厚重的裤子（doesn't mean that you wear thick trousers对应建议不要带C选项）。
你可能会听到前面说的“properly dressed”就以为建议带厚衣服，但录音随后立刻用“doesn't mean”进行了否定，并推荐了更轻便防水的衣物。
But basically, we do say that you should be properly dressed. Now, it must be emphasized that this doesn't mean that you wear thick trousers like jeans. Lighter, waterproof apparel is better.
录音说有些人喜欢带手机（like to bring），说明手机是可以带的，全看个人意愿（对应可以带B选项）。
你可能会听到“isn't always a good signal（信号不好）”以为是不建议带，但这只是在陈述客观信号限制，并没有禁止或建议你别带。
Some people like to bring their mobile phones, but there isn't always a good signal. And remember, the checkpoints are there, so you can always rely on those.
录音直截了当地说带手电筒纯属浪费空间和重量（waste of space and weight），说明极度不建议带（对应建议不要带C选项）。
你可能会听到“Some people asked if they should bring”误以为是可以带，但紧随其后的“but frankly”直接引出了强烈的负面评价，彻底打消了带手电筒的必要性。
Some people asked if they should bring a torch, but frankly, they're a waste of space and weight.
录音提到是否自己携带高能量饮料等补给品完全取决于你自己（up to you对应可以带B选项）。
你可能会把更早前提到报名费包含的“juice”跟这里混淆，注意这里讨论的是自己额外携带的物品，而“up to you”是典型的“随你便/可以带”同义替换。
Another thing people ask about is refreshments. Whether you carry things like high-energy drinks is up to you.
录音明确表示带背包是一个“非常好的主意”（very good idea对应强烈建议带A选项）。
你可能会因为后面跟着一句“what size is up to the individual（大小取决于个人）”而错选B，但这仅仅是说大小随意，带包这个行为本身官方是极力推荐的。
And finally, we say it's a very good idea to bring a rucksack, but what size is up to the individual.
